scope: CPU-only actual Three.js authority, scene graph, surface alignment and lifecycle tests with injected DataTexture fixtures. No browser, WebGL or visual-art approval.

cases.name: one fire uses its event frame while the bullet follows actual state for any age
duplicate fire/hit and terminal replays never add logical effects
expiry, disappearance and cancelled projectiles do not invent contact
combat-clear, defeat and harbor-return hide all layers and bar stale state replay
missing projectile height and zero velocity use the fire frame without changing sim data
generation filters stale high sequences before current events and allows retry IDs
dt0 pauses ages and opacity; normal update resumes only once
hit core and six soft spark planes keep actual surface normals while orbiting
reset detaches and clears references; reused effects match a fresh instance
unsupported weapons and invalid contacts do not attach soft MG effects
simultaneous shots respect active/pool caps while receipts and input stay independent
real swept sim contact alone creates a soft impact and cannot be mutated by display
dispose is idempotent and owns only cloned textures, not caller atlases

limits: Generated atlas pixels, shader compilation, actual browser rendering and game-screen readability are not checked by texture fixtures.
These tests do not connect or modify the integration renderer, original sim, damage, audio or camera impulse.
